title: Electric Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field E at the center of the hollow sphere as E = (rho / (3 * epsilon_0)) * a.

title: Potential Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the potential phi at the center of the hollow sphere as phi = (rho / (6 * epsilon_0)) * [3(R1^2 - R2^2) - a^2].

title: Superposition Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the superposition principle correctly in the context of electric fields and potentials.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration steps for finding the potential from the electric field.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of electric field and potential.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the final expressions for E and phi.
